summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by modifying the coordinate checking logic based on the evaluation flag. It seems to handle the specific case where `evaluate(False)` is used.

issues.description: The patch introduces a special-case handling for `evaluate(False)`, which may lead to test overfitting. It assumes that the issue is solely related to the evaluation flag, but other factors might also contribute to the problem.
The code could benefit from additional comments explaining the logic behind the conditional checks for imaginary coordinates.
